verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Vercel has a CLI and REST/OpenAPI API (vercel-probe-3, vercel-probe-4), which could theoretically enable scripted bulk actions, but no documentation or example describes a bulk-operations capability (e.g., bulk deploy, bulk env-var update, batch project management) for AI-native or any users. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-operation endpoints/CLI commands, docs describing batch processing, and any hands-on evidence of performing operations across many items at once.
